ns2:section.sectionText: This section has an online format and requires access to Mathematica-based courseware. Students will receive information about how to sign up for an account in Mathable ($99) after enrollment in the course. Must have taken a transfer course which articulates as Math 24-. If this is the case, please e-mail mathadvising@illinois.edu with name, NetID, UIN, and request for Math 292 approval. This course contains multiple paper-based exams that must be taken with an approved proctor. Exams may be taken on campus with NetMath proctoring; for off-campus options see https://netmath.illinois.edu/offcampus. A 16-week self-paced version of this class will also be available as part of the academic year term (not summer term). Registration for the self-paced class is done through https://netmath.illinois.edu/Register (not Self-Service). This course requires multiple paper-based exams that must be taken with an approved proctor. Exams may be taken on campus with NetMath proctoring; for off-campus options see https://netmath.illinois.edu/offcampus. Off-campus proctors must be able to scan completed exams and email them to NetMath for grading, as well as mailing the paper exam back for archival purposes.
